title: 9-7 SHOOTOUT: Globo Gym King Cobras Outlast Fire Truck Club in Wild Third-Period Battle
description:
Fire Truck Club D vs. Globo Gym King Cobras D — Game #7774
Final Score: King Cobras 9 – Fire Truck Club 7
Date: 07/26/26 • League: BH Adult D • Location: Baptist Health Iceplex Rink 2
Period by Period: Fire Truck Club 2-3-2 (7) | King Cobras 4-2-3 (9)

King Cobras actually jumped out front early, not Fire Truck Club, and the two teams traded body blows for three periods before Dominic Rosalez's empty-net finish, his fourth goal of the night, closed out a 16-goal shootout.

📝 Game Notes
King Cobras controlled the first period start to finish, building a 4-2 cushion before Fire Truck Club twice fought back to tie it, at 4-4 and again at 5-5, only for King Cobras to answer both times. Dominic Rosalez was the difference-maker, scoring in every period and capping the night with the empty-netter. Frank Kaminski's third-period incident, a roughing minor stacked with a 10-minute misconduct, came in the same sequence as King Cobras' empty-net insurance goal.
